description: This file is a TypeScript source code for importing Todoist data into a board and card system, converting projects, sections, and items into visual board representations with properties and views.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Interface representing a section within a project, used for categorizing items.

classes.name: Todoist
classes.description: Main interface representing the entire Todoist data structure, including projects, sections, notes, and items.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, reads input file, processes projects, and writes output archive.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a Todoist project into board and block representations.

methods.name: getProjectColumns
methods.description: Retrieves columns (sections) for a project, defaulting if none are specified.

methods.name: getProjectCards
methods.description: Filters items belonging to a specific project.

methods.name: getCardDescription
methods.description: Generates description text for a card, including attachments.
